related.title: HTTP Cache：Age、max-age 與新鮮度
related.titleEn: HTTP Cache: Age, max-age and freshness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受1535/17919 B並同時檢查stream與connection window，不因單層通過就傳送。 交接時須能核對：交付 h2-flow.csv、三層長度圖與padding邊界測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept1535/17919 B and check both stream and connection windows before sending. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver h2-flow.csv, three-layer length diagrams and padding-boundary tests.
related.difference: 保存Date、Age、response time及resident time，明示初始age已做傳輸校正。
related.differenceEn: Preserve Date, Age, response time and residence time and state that initial age is already transit-corrected.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
HTTP/2流控計入整個DATA payload含padding相關欄位，但不含9 B frame header。
教學基準：65535-4*16000 = 1535 B credit；對照：65535-4*16000+16384 = 17919 B credit。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

HTTP新鮮度依目前age及freshness lifetime比較；收取回應後不能重新從零計原始年齡。
教學基準：600-(120+200) = 280 s freshness margin；對照：600-(120+520) = -40 s freshness margin。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
HTTP/2 flow control counts the full DATA payload including padding-related fields, excluding the9 B frame header.
Teaching baseline: 65535-4*16000 = 1535 B credit; comparison: 65535-4*16000+16384 = 17919 B credit. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

HTTP freshness compares current age against lifetime; receiving a response does not reset its original age to zero.
Teaching baseline: 600-(120+200) = 280 s freshness margin; comparison: 600-(120+520) = -40 s freshness margin. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Separate the first two nonrepeaters from three table columns and retain OID order for each repetition.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

GetBulk以non-repeaters與max-repetitions控制結果數；endOfMibView與訊息容量可使實際結果更少。
教學基準：2+(5-2)*10 = 32 varbind upper bound；對照：2+(5-2)*20 = 62 varbind upper bound。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
